Thanks for agreeing to complete our SIG intake. Our procurement team is asking for a focused deliverable we can slot into our security review: a simple CSV or spreadsheet listing all subprocessors/third-party vendors that may process ACME data, along with (for each):
- Vendor name and primary contact
- Service category (cloud compute, telemetry/analytics, support/ticketing, auth, etc.)

- Hosting region(s)
- SOC 2 / ISO / other attestations (link or date)

Mina —

Attached is a first-pass CSV (subprocessors_draft.csv). High-level vendor categories included:
- Cloud compute: AWS (us-east-1, us-west-2) — handles model hosting, KV cache backups; SOC 2 Type II (link).
- Object storage: GCS (us-central1) — model artifacts/backups (used in limited private deployments).
